name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v3435: The CDP read had no bound, so the UNKNOWN arm in render_check for a stalled browser was dead code from the day it shipped. The v3434 push rendered 1 of 20 targets, went silent, and was killed at 300s as render HUNG — a sentence naming no link — and the kill took the shared Chrome down so crest-loudness refused too. create_connection now carries _CDP_READ_TIMEOUT (90s, derived from the 248s full-set cost and the 300s hook bound), so a silent socket becomes a reported UNKNOWN. 2 gates, 4/4 red-proofs.
